video_caption: The video opens with an animated patriotic background of blue and red stripes with white stars. The initials "LWV" appear, followed by the full text "LEAGUE OF WOMEN VOTERS OF PORTLAND". The scene then transitions to show a blue outline of the state of Oregon, which fills with red. A circular "VOTE" button with white stars appears, followed by a red, white, and blue banner with the text "DEMOCRACY". The background then changes to a solid red, with a large red and white star, featuring a blue star in its center, in the bottom left corner. A blue banner with white stars slides in, displaying the text "ELECTION 2020". Below this, additional text appears: "Video Voters' Guide" at the top right, and "Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 4 Keith Wilson" at the bottom. The video then cuts to a medium shot of Chris Cobey, a middle-aged man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt, a dark blue tie with white polka dots, and white wired earbuds. He is speaking directly to the camera, with a white bookshelf filled with books and decorations in the background. A lower third graphic identifies him as "Chris Cobey League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org". He introduces himself and the purpose of the video.

A man with short, light brown hair and silver hoop earrings, wearing a light blue button-up shirt over a white undershirt, speaks directly to the camera with a friendly and engaging expression from what appears to be an office setting. Behind him, there's a window with blinds, a printer, and a black filing cabinet topped with framed pictures and a small globe. At 00:07, a white box with blue text appears in the bottom left corner, displaying "LWV" (stylized logo) and "Video Voters' Guide League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org," which provides context for the video as an election resource. At 00:36, the video transitions to a split-screen view: the man from the initial segment is now on the right, looking at another man on the left. The man on the left has short brown hair, wears a light blue collared shirt with a striped tie, and has an earpiece; he looks down and then up as if listening or preparing to speak. A green and white "MetroEast" logo appears in the bottom right corner of the split screen.

Two men are engaged in a video call. The man on the left has brown hair and is wearing a light blue collared shirt with a patterned tie and wired earbuds. He is mostly still, attentively listening. The man on the right has short, light brown hair and is wearing a light blue collared shirt; he is actively speaking to the camera, using hand gestures and displaying an animated expression with wide eyes to emphasize his points. His background includes a window with blinds, a printer, a skull decoration, and a filing cabinet with framed pictures. The man on the left has a bookshelf filled with books and decorative items behind him. At the 0:00 mark, a white text overlay appears at the bottom of the screen, reading "LWV Keith Wilson Candidate Portland City Commissioner District 4," identifying the man on the right.

In the video segment, a man with short, light brown hair, dressed in a light blue button-up shirt over a white undershirt, speaks directly to the camera in what appears to be an office setting. Behind him, a window with blinds is on the left, and a dark filing cabinet with a skull-like object and framed pictures is on the right. A white printer is visible on the left. The scene then transitions to a split screen, with the first man on the right. On the left, a second man with wavy dark brown hair, wearing a light blue shirt and a dark tie with an earbud in his left ear, is shown in a different indoor setting with bookshelves behind him. Below both men, a banner appears with the text "LWW Vote411.org lwvpdX.org". The "LWW" likely refers to the "League of Women Voters," and the websites provide information related to voting and the League of Women Voters' Portland chapter.

The video displays a split-screen view of two men participating in a video call. The man on the left, with short brown hair, wears a light blue collared shirt with a dark patterned tie and white earbuds. He looks forward, speaking, with a bookshelf and framed items visible in the background behind him. The man on the right, with short grey hair, wears a light blue collared shirt and also looks forward, listening, with horizontal blinds covering a window, a printer, and office furniture visible in his background. A skull and other decorative items are on top of a filing cabinet behind him. Below the split screen, a banner with a red and white striped pattern features the "LWW" logo (League of Women Voters) on the left, followed by "Vote411.org" and "lwvpdx.org" in white text. At the 0:23 mark, the camera zooms in slightly on the man on the right as he begins to speak.

A light-haired man in a light blue button-up shirt, worn over a white undershirt, speaks directly to the camera with a serious and engaged expression in what appears to be an office setting. Behind him, window blinds are visible on the left, and to his right, there's a dark file cabinet topped with framed pictures and a small decorative object, possibly a globe or skull; a white printer is also visible on a desk to his far left. From 00:06 to 00:16, a white text overlay with a blue and red stripe appears at the bottom of the screen, reading: "Video Voters' Guide League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org," indicating the context of the video. The man maintains eye contact with the camera and continues speaking intently throughout the segment.

In this video segment, a fair-skinned man with short, light-colored hair and glasses, wearing a light blue button-up shirt over a white undershirt, is speaking directly to the camera. He is seated in what appears to be an office, with horizontal blinds visible through a window to his left. To his right, a black filing cabinet holds a small, light-colored spherical object and a few framed pictures. A white printer or scanner is on a desk to his left. He speaks expressively, using hand gestures to emphasize his points. A banner at the bottom of the screen displays the "LWV" logo on the left, and text that reads "Keith Wilson" and below it, "Candidate Portland City Commissioner District 4".

The video opens with a middle-aged man, with short, light hair and wearing a light blue button-down shirt, speaking directly to the camera from what appears to be an office setting. Behind him, to the left, are window blinds, and to the right, a printer and dark filing cabinets with a small globe and a picture frame on top. At 0:04, the screen splits horizontally to reveal another man, older with dark hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a dark tie, on the left side of the screen. He has earbuds in and is also looking at the camera, with a bookshelf visible in his background. The original speaker continues to be shown on the right side of the split screen. At 0:05, the screen transitions back to showing only the first man, who continues to speak with a serious but engaged expression, occasionally using hand gestures. At 0:11, a white and blue graphic appears at the bottom of the screen, displaying the text "LWV Vote411.org lwvppdx.org", which likely refers to the League of Women Voters and voter information resources. The man continues to speak until the end of the segment, maintaining eye contact with the camera.

In a split-screen video call, an older man with light-brown hair and a light blue shirt with a patterned tie is on the left, speaking with a wired earbud in his right ear, his mouth moving as he talks. Behind him is a bookshelf filled with books and some framed decor on the wall, with a green object partially visible at the bottom right of his frame. On the right, a younger man with short light-brown hair and a light blue collared shirt is listening intently, occasionally nodding slightly. His background features a window with blinds, a printer, a filing cabinet, and some decorative items including what appears to be a skull and framed pictures. In the bottom left corner of the left man's screen, a blue and red logo for "LWV" is displayed, likely representing the League of Women Voters.

Two men are seen on a video call, initially in a split screen. The man on the left, older, wears a light blue shirt with a tie and white earbuds, remaining largely still. The man on the right, younger, with short grey hair and wearing a light blue button-up shirt, is speaking directly to the camera and using hand gestures to emphasize his points. The video then zooms in on the man on the right, showing his office background which includes a window with blinds, a white printer, and a dark filing cabinet with a small globe and framed items on top. From 0:08, a banner appears at the bottom of the screen. On the left side of the banner, the letters "LWV" are displayed in white on a blue background. On the right, the text "Video Voters' Guide" is shown, followed by "League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org" in white text on a red and blue striped background. The speaker emphasizes his qualifications, mentioning a master's degree in transportation and finance, and his 20 years of experience running a complex transportation organization, stating he is a "green transportation" expert and understands road taxes, concluding that he is a "perfect fit."

A middle-aged man with short, light-colored hair and a light blue button-up shirt over a white undershirt is speaking directly to the camera, making hand gestures to emphasize his points. He has a serious and engaged expression. The background behind him shows an office setting with a window on the left, horizontal blinds, a white printer, and stacked papers. On the right, there's a dark filing cabinet with a globe, a framed picture, and other small items on top. At 0:40, a white text overlay appears at the bottom, displaying "LWV Vote411.org lwvpdx.org". Shortly after, at 0:41, a colorful logo with a stylized green and orange "mE" (resembling mountains) and the text "MetroEast" below it appears above the white text overlay.

The video opens with a medium shot of a fair-skinned man with short, light brown hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt over a white undershirt. He is speaking directly to the camera, gesturing with his right hand, and appears to be in an office setting with a window and blinds to his left and a filing cabinet, a small globe, and framed items to his right. A "MetroEast" logo with green and orange elements is displayed in the bottom right corner. At the 0:13 mark, the screen splits horizontally into two sections. The man on the right (first speaker) continues to speak and gesture. On the left, another fair-skinned man with dark, wavy hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt and a dark tie, is shown. He has wired earbuds in and looks slightly downwards, with a neutral expression. His background includes a bookshelf and framed items on a wall. The "MetroEast" logo remains in the bottom right corner of the right panel throughout the segment.

The video shows a split-screen view of two men engaged in a video call. On the left, a man with brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and a dark tie, is speaking into white earbuds. Behind him, bookshelves filled with books and framed items on the wall are visible, suggesting an office or study setting. On the right, another man with short grey hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt, is listening intently, looking forward with a neutral expression. His background includes blinds on a window, a white printer, and a shelf with a globe and framed pictures. In the bottom-left corner of the screen, the "LWV" logo (likely representing the League of Women Voters) with a red line underneath is displayed. As the man on the left is speaking about law enforcement, police-community relations, the use of deadly force, and officer accountability, the audio suddenly cuts out with a high-pitched, distorted sound.

A man with short, light brown hair and wearing a light blue collared shirt looks directly at the camera and speaks from what appears to be an office setting. Behind him to the left, a window with horizontal blinds is visible, and on the desk in the foreground, a white printer sits. To his right, a black filing cabinet holds a globe, a framed landscape picture, and another small framed item with multiple pictures. A lower third graphic appears below him, displaying the text "LWV Keith Wilson Candidate Portland City Commissioner District 4" (LWV Keith Wilson Candidate Portland City Commissioner District 4), identifying him as a political candidate.

A middle-aged man with short, light-colored hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt over a white undershirt, is speaking directly to the camera from the chest up in what appears to be an office setting. He uses hand gestures as he talks, with his mouth open and an engaged expression, often raising his eyebrows for emphasis. Behind him to his left, part of a white printer or copier is visible, and to his right, a dark filing cabinet holds a globe and framed pictures on top. A window with horizontal blinds is visible in the background. At the 00:19 mark, a graphic overlay appears at the bottom of the screen, featuring the "LWV" logo on the left and the text "Video Voters' Guide" followed by "League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org" on the right. The man continues to speak and gesture with his hands, maintaining his earnest and expressive demeanor until the end of the segment.

A middle-aged man with short, light brown hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt, is seated and speaking directly into the camera with a serious expression. He appears to be in an office setting. To his left, a window with horizontal blinds is visible, partially obscured by a white printer or scanner on a desk. Behind him, a dark shelf unit holds papers and files. Further to his right, on top of a dark filing cabinet, there's a small globe, a framed picture (possibly a landscape), another framed object that looks like a diagram or medical image, and a small photo frame with what appears to be a picture of people. The wall in the background is a light, neutral color.

The video opens with a split screen showing two men. On the left, a man with short dark hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt and a dark tie, speaks into a microphone, looking directly at the camera. He wears white earbuds. On the right, another man with short grey hair, wearing a similar light blue shirt, smiles and listens. A banner at the bottom of the screen displays "LWV" (League of Women Voters logo), "Vote411.org," and "lwvpdx.org." At 00:09, the view transitions to a close-up of the man on the left, continuing to speak with a bookshelf and framed items visible in the background. At 00:21, the scene cuts to a solid blue background with a vertical column of white stars on the left. White text appears on the screen, reading: "League of Women Voters of Portland Presents" (English), "The Video Voters' Guide" (English), "For more voter information:" (English), followed by the "LWV" logo, "Vote411.org" (English), and "lwvpdx.org" (English). At 00:29, the text changes to "Don't forget to cast your ballot! Primary Election May 19th." (English), while the voter information section remains the same. At 00:36, the text updates to thank sponsors, listing "Multnomah Bar Foundation" (English), "Carol & Velma Saling Foundation" (English), "Vernier Software & Technology" (English), and "The Wyss Foundation" (English) "for their generous support." (English).
